Recommendation for Nintendo Emulators for Zelda

"Dolphin" is a fantastic emulator for GameCube and Wii games. You can even use a Wii remote or GameCube controller with it (or Xbox or ps3 controller if you interface it right).

Project64 works well for N64 games. They even have "Prokect64K" which supports net play/multiplayer on games like Smash Bros.
Dolphins great, so long as you have the original disc.

• NES - jNES 1.1.1
  • SNES - SNES9x 1.53
  • N64 - Project 64

Until we get an all-inclusive app like OpenEMU for Mac, we're stuck mashing up multiple emulators separately. There is a nice frontend in the works for PC users called Snowflake, but it hasn't been released yet. There is also a frontend project for RetroArch called Phoenix, but it also hasn't been released yet.
